access.account_hacked_or_locked.title: Hacked or locked-out accounts with no recovery help
access.account_hacked_or_locked.description: Users report their accounts were hacked or linked profiles lost, leaving them locked out, unable to recover playlists, and getting no useful support.

access.logged_out.title: App logs users out and blocks re-login
access.logged_out.description: Users say the app logs them out unexpectedly, often after updates, and then they cannot log back in, losing saved songs and playlists.

access.login_failure.title: Users cannot log in to the app
access.login_failure.description: Users report that the app refuses valid credentials or shows connection errors, preventing them from logging in at all.
access.login_failure.suggested_split: Login blocked by connection or server errors

access.other.title: Blocked access, regional limits, and library restrictions
access.other.description: Users report being unable to use the app in certain countries, not opening liked songs or library, and needing the app for basic account access.
access.other.suggested_split: Regional blocking; Library or liked songs not opening; Paired family account fai

access.password_reset.title: Password reset is difficult or unavailable
access.password_reset.description: Users cannot retrieve or reset their password after being logged out or locked out, and some threaten to close their accounts.

access.signup.title: Account signup fails or is blocked
access.signup.description: Users cannot create new accounts because signup errors out, rejects birthdates, demands VPN removal, or requires email or phone details.

billing.cancel_or_refund.title: Subscription cancellation is difficult and charges continue
billing.cancel_or_refund.description: Users say cancelling premium is hard or ineffective and they keep being charged after cancelling.

billing.other.title: Payment errors and pushy billing behavior
billing.other.description: Users face payment errors with mobile load or cards, and feel the app is dishonest or constantly pushes premium subscriptions.
billing.other.suggested_split: Payment method failures; Persistent upsell and reminder prompts

billing.plans_family_student.title: Premium plan options and pricing frustrate users
billing.plans_family_student.description: Users object to premium-only pricing structure, missing annual or student options, and repeated prompts to buy family or premium plans.

billing.premium_only_controls.title: Basic playback controls moved behind premium paywall
billing.premium_only_controls.description: Users say features such as skipping to parts of a song, repeating, shuffle control, and ordering are now restricted to paid premium subscribers.

billing.price.title: Subscription price considered too high
billing.price.description: Users feel Premium costs are too high relative to value and competitors, calling the app money-hungry.

billing.subscription_activation.title: Premium subscription fails to activate or upgrade
billing.subscription_activation.description: Users report errors, delays, or ineligibility messages when trying to subscribe, activate Duo, or renew Premium.

billing.unexpected_charges.title: Charged after cancelling or unexpectedly
billing.unexpected_charges.description: Users report being charged again after cancelling or unsubscribing, or charged for things they did not expect.

catalog.lyrics.title: Song lyrics not loading or missing
catalog.lyrics.description: Users say lyrics fail to load or have disappeared from songs in the app.

catalog.missing_or_removed_content.title: Songs and content unavailable or missing
catalog.missing_or_removed_content.description: Users find previously available songs, artists, playlist tracks, or podcasts unavailable or not playing.

catalog.other.title: Miscellaneous catalog and playback complaints
catalog.other.description: A mixed set of complaints about song selection, playlist contents, stream counts, regional language and rule fairness.
catalog.other.suggested_split: Playlist contents and liked-songs display issues; artist and stream-count fairne

catalog.podcasts_audiobooks.title: Podcast video and audiobook access problems
catalog.podcasts_audiobooks.description: Users cannot watch video podcasts, find audiobooks free, or understand how podcasts are mixed with music.

catalog.recommendations.title: Recommendations repeat or ignore user settings
catalog.recommendations.description: Users say recommended songs repeat, get added to playlists despite settings, or daily mixes disappeared.

catalog.search.title: Search returns wrong or missing results
catalog.search.description: Users report searches returning wrong songs, missing artists, failing to show results, or stalling while loading.

downloads.download_failure.title: Music downloads fail or are very slow
downloads.download_failure.description: Users cannot download music for offline listening, or downloads take excessively long.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded songs disappearing unexpectedly from library
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: Users report saved or downloaded songs and playlists get removed or re-download repeatedly, often after updates, forcing them to re-download content.
downloads.downloads_disappear.suggested_split: Downloads removed after app update; Downloaded mixes or playlists auto-refreshin

downloads.offline_mode.title: Downloaded music won't play offline without internet
downloads.offline_mode.description: Users say downloaded songs and playlists still require an internet connection to start playing, buffer forever, or are unavailable offline unless they pay for a subscription.

downloads.other.title: Download controls and local file playback problems
downloads.other.description: Users struggle to find the download button, cannot download individual songs, and report local audio files being unplayable or hard to add.
downloads.other.suggested_split: Missing download button or per-song download removed; Local files cannot be play

downloads.storage.title: Cannot store downloads on SD card
downloads.storage.description: Users cannot save downloaded songs to an SD card and say the app takes up too much phone storage.

other.boycott_political.title: Boycott calls tied to political and religious grievances
other.boycott_political.description: Reviewers call for boycotting the app over Sweden, Quran burnings, and political decisions about artist content.

other.general_criticism.title: General dissatisfaction and negative sentiment
other.general_criticism.description: Reviewers express broad negative opinions about the app, often citing updates making it worse, with no specific product problem named.

other.general_praise.title: Mostly positive feedback with minor complaints
other.general_praise.description: Reviewers generally like the app while noting small issues, comparisons to other services, or data usage concerns.
other.general_praise.suggested_split: Switched to competitor apps; Data usage concerns

other.other.title: Complaints about recent updates and missing features
other.other.description: Users say recent updates made the app worse, with some noting missing canvas feature and weaker lyrics or download features compared to Tidal.
other.other.suggested_split: Recent update degraded app experience; Missing canvas feature; Competitors offer

other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.title: Off-topic or unintelligible review text
other.unrelated_or_unintelligible.description: Reviews are off-topic, political, or written in a way that does not describe a product problem.

playback.audio_quality.title: Audio is too quiet, noisy, or distorted
playback.audio_quality.description: Users report music playing too low, sounding distorted or noisy, crossfade malfunctioning, and poorer quality than competing apps.
playback.audio_quality.suggested_split: Low volume and loudness; Distorted or noisy playback; Crossfade malfunction

playback.background_play.title: Unwanted playback starting or stopping unexpectedly
playback.background_play.description: Music auto-starts on connection or stops when the app is backgrounded, locked, or another app opens.
playback.background_play.suggested_split: Auto-start on connection vs. playback stopping when app is backgrounded

playback.battery_resource_use.title: App drains battery and runs in background
playback.battery_resource_use.description: Users report the app keeps running in the background, draining battery and wasting data even when disabled.

playback.connection_errors.title: App wrongly reports no internet connection
playback.connection_errors.description: The app shows offline or no-connection messages even when the device has working internet via Wi-Fi or cellular.

playback.crashes_or_wont_open.title: App crashes, freezes, or fails to open
playback.crashes_or_wont_open.description: The app force-closes, shows blank screens, or refuses to load or play after updates.

playback.device_connectivity.title: Unreliable casting and speaker connectivity
playback.device_connectivity.description: Casting to smart speakers and other devices fails, jumps to wrong playlists, or desyncs between devices.

playback.lag_or_slow.title: App is laggy and slow to load
playback.lag_or_slow.description: Users experience lag, slow loading of songs and screens, and sluggish performance.

playback.other.title: Miscellaneous playback and update problems
playback.other.description: A mix of update issues, wrong notification info, sharing errors, and empty or non-working app behavior.
playback.other.suggested_split: Sharing and notification display errors vs. general update instability

playback.stops_or_skips.title: Music pauses, stops, or fails to play
playback.stops_or_skips.description: Songs stop mid-play, pause on their own, fail to start, or cut out and judder.

support.contact_difficulty.title: Hard to find or reach customer support
support.contact_difficulty.description: Users cannot locate a support contact option and find the support process frustrating.

support.no_response.title: Support messages go unanswered
support.no_response.description: Users say their messages and reviews receive no reply from the support team.

support.unhelpful_response.title: Support is unhelpful and unresponsive
support.unhelpful_response.description: Customers report rude, useless support and email glitches, with issues like unauthorized cancellation and no refunds or credits offered.

usability.ads.title: Too many ads interrupt listening
usability.ads.description: Users find ads too frequent, including on premium accounts and after tracks or podcasts.

usability.controls.title: Playback controls removed or broken
usability.controls.description: Users say basic playback controls such as seeking, rewinding, repeat, speed, and skipping are missing or malfunctioning.

usability.navigation_layout.title: Navigation and layout are hard to use
usability.navigation_layout.description: Users find the app unintuitive to navigate, with a clumsy layout, cropped images, and missing shortcuts such as recently played.

usability.other.title: Miscellaneous complaints about restrictions and features
usability.other.description: Scattered complaints about restrictions, feature removals, unwanted notifications and permissions, and wasted data.
usability.other.suggested_split: Unwanted notifications and permissions; feature removals and restrictions

usability.queue_playlist_management.title: Playlist and queue editing is broken
usability.queue_playlist_management.description: Users cannot reliably sort, edit, or find songs in playlists and queues, and songs are unexpectedly added.

usability.redesign_update.title: Users dislike the redesign and updates
usability.redesign_update.description: Many users dislike the new UI and recent updates, citing unnecessary changes to icons, layout, and behavior.

usability.shuffle_autoplay.title: Shuffle plays unwanted songs
usability.shuffle_autoplay.description: Users say shuffle mixes in unrelated songs, smart shuffle cannot be disabled, and skip limits and looping are restricted.

usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.title: Widgets and notifications malfunction
usability.widgets_notifications_lockscre.description: Users report widgets not working or removed, lock-screen and notification controls that cannot be dismissed, and missing heart buttons on wearables.
